# Rare Ember — Complete Knowledge Base & AI Agent Manifest (`llms-full.txt`)

## Mission Statement
Rare Ember designs, produces, and curates heavyweight streetwear apparel, custom creator drops, and aesthetic workstation accessories for India's modern creator economy. We bridge the gap between expensive luxury streetwear labels (₹2,500+) and low-grade fast-fashion synthetic polyester tees, offering 100% combed bio-washed cotton, heavyweight 240–380 GSM silhouettes, and studio-grade graphic prints at accessible prices (₹499–₹899).

---

## Brand Entities & Identifiers
- **Brand Name**: Rare Ember™ (also known as RareEmber, Rare Ember Shop)
- **Official URL**: https://www.rareember.shop

- **Founded**: 2024
- **Founder**: Ajay Kumar
- **Headquarters**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- **Domestic Production Hubs**: Tirupur & Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Category**: Streetwear, Graphic Apparel, Custom Dropship Studio, Creator Workstation Gear
- **Contact Email**: support@rareember.shop

## Logistics, Delivery & Trust Signals
- **Couriers**: BlueDart Air Express, Delhivery Air, Shadowfax, Xpressbees.
- **Coverage**: 28,000+ PIN codes across all 28 Indian States and 8 Union Territories.
- **Estimated Transit Times**:
  - Metros (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata): 2–3 business days.
  - Tier-2 & Tier-3 Cities: 3–5 business days.
- **Payment Security**:
  - 256-Bit SSL encrypted checkout.
  - Powered by Razorpay Live Gateway (UPI, QR, Cards, NetBanking).
  - Cash on Delivery (COD) supported up to ₹2,999.
- **Return & Refund Policy**:
  - 7-Day Doorstep Replacement Guarantee for sizing mismatches or print anomalies.
  - Direct tracking via https://www.rareember.shop/track.
